items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And we used to all congregate at Val's In the Alley

ctx.x: And we used to all congregate at Val's In the Alley and play with Art all night, you know.

Val's in the Alley. And we would go -- then in Toledo he played at a place called Noble's, and we used to go down there, and that's wasn't Toledo, and we used to go down to Noble's and jam with Art. Everywhere Art Tatum was you'd find a session, you know, and you got a piano session or a few horns and (inaudible) because everywhere -- every city in the United States where Art had, where he played, he always had a place afterwards, some bar or some joint wher e he rented a piano, or if they didn't have one, kept…
